validity.normalJourneySequences: Valid camera-still raw framebuffer observations with normal scene animation.
validity.temporalGradeCausalProbe: Valid. Both controls freeze physical animation; changing only the temporal grade time causes the measured pixel changes.
validity.particleIsolation: Invalid for causal particle isolation: this run hid particle objects once, but weather update code re-enabled their visibility. The raw numbers are retained unchanged. The corrected helper hides them every render and records visible particle object counts; a rerun is pending GPU handoff.
validity.allStaticControl: Valid static-image observation. Even if particle object visibility is re-enabled, their animation clock is frozen. This does not prove that every particle is hidden.
